scope: Same completed 24 simulated states x 2 versions x 3 strategies; not 144 new cases or users.

definitions.root: The single executor, coordinator, or on-demand root; expert subtask finish requests are counted separately.
definitions.root_first_finish_accepted: An accepted final report with no earlier root finish rejection. Every run has >=1 root finish request and no model message contains multiple root finishes in these data.
definitions.root_content_rejection: report_rejected trace from citation or operation/source checks.
definitions.root_control_rejection: tool_rejected trace for root finish, including schema and routing checks.
definitions.following_work: All model calls initiated after the first root finish rejection, excluding the call that produced it. May include necessary business work and experts; not wholly attributable to the gate.
definitions.cost: Sum of original per-call estimated_cost_cny; no repricing. This is not provider billing or account balance.
definitions.latency: Following-call latency is the sum of recorded model request latencies, not full wall-clock recovery time or hidden reasoning duration.
definitions.task_passed: Original evaluation.passed, never rescored; it happens to match accepted-root-report status in this dataset.

limitations: No gate-disabled control; no causal claim that a gate caused these recoveries or that later costs disappear without it.
